title: SafeDeploymentManifest
description: Exactly the fields D4 requires to be persisted for the resident Safe (week-1-frozen-delivery-contract.md section 4, D4). Shape only: every concrete value is [arbitrary] and awaits the Account gate (section 7, checkpoint 2). The input fields mirror @kade/shared SafeDeploymentInputs; the persisted fields mirror its SafeDeploymentRecord. No deployment, registration or broadcast is implied by this file.

$comment.description: Free-form note. Must state that the manifest is unapproved while provenance is unapproved.

deploymentTxHash.description: Ethereum Sepolia deployment transaction. D4: stored. null until the Safe is actually deployed; the L2-only case stays null. [arbitrary] until the Account gate.

safeAddress.description: The single resident Safe address. D4 requires it to be identical on every active chain (iteration 1: Ethereum Sepolia and Base Sepolia, contract v1.6). [arbitrary] until derived from Account-gate inputs.

predictedL2Addresses.description: Counterfactual L2 addresses. D4: stored. Each must equal safeAddress (see tests/SafeAddress.t.sol). Iteration 1 predicts Base Sepolia only; Arbitrum is deferred (contract v1.6). [arbitrary].

chainId.description: Base Sepolia (84532) is the active prediction; Arbitrum Sepolia (421614) is deferred by contract v1.6 but the shape still accepts it. [documented].

safeVersion.description: Safe contract version, e.g. "1.5.0". Decided by the project owner (contract v1.6).

factory.description: SafeProxyFactory used for CREATE2. [arbitrary] — Account gate.

singleton.description: Safe singleton (master copy) the proxy delegates to. [arbitrary] — Account gate.

initializer.description: Safe setup initializer calldata (WebAuthn signer, threshold 1). Its keccak256 is the on-chain salt input. [arbitrary] — Account gate.

handler.description: CompatibilityFallbackHandler stored in the Safe. [arbitrary] — Account gate.

owner.description: The direct Safe WebAuthn signer: the only operational owner, no user EOA (frozen: section 2, items 5-6). Address [arbitrary] — Account gate.

salt.description: CREATE2 salt inputs and output. [arbitrary] until Account-gate inputs.

saltNonce.description: uint256 salt nonce passed to createProxyWithNonce. [arbitrary].

creationCodeAssumptions.description: The exact byte-level assumptions the predicted address depends on. A change to any of these changes the address (proved in tests/SafeAddress.t.sol).

proxyCreationCodeHash.description: keccak256(type(SafeProxy).creationCode) for the pinned Safe version/compiler. [arbitrary] — derived from the Account-gate Safe version and the pinned solc.

chainSpecific.description: D4 uses createProxyWithNonce, which does not fold chain id into the salt, so the address is chain-independent. [documented].

provenance.description: unapproved in Week 1. Flipped only when the Account gate approves the concrete inputs and the Sepolia deployment is recorded. Deployment is out of scope for this deliverable.
